WHAT_THIS_IS: Every number below is a count or order statistic over stored TB@DAL 2026W5 worlds. No probability was invented, no language model was called, no sportsbook price was read. Betting use is out of scope.
CAVEAT: An answer is only as good as the worlds. Known defects of the underlying worlds: lower-tail volatility under-stated (D-01); event accounting inconsistent in the incumbent (PRODUCTION) worlds (D-05), which is why the SHADOW event-consistent worlds are answered side by side. The SHADOW arm is research only and is consumed by no production path.

dk_alignment.MEANING: share of player-world cells where DK recomputed from the stored stat line equals the stored draw (within 0.06, or exactly a 3-point bonus line from 0.1-yd storage rounding)

SHADOW.draws_shadow_only: research arm; not consumed by any production path
